notes: Synthetic: authored by hand, 2026-10-28. ai.google.dev and docs.cloud.google.com were blocked by this session's network policy, so the field names and enums come from the machine-readable form of the official REST reference (ai.google.dev/api/generate-content): the generativelanguage v1beta discovery document, revision 20261028 (GenerateContentResponse, Candidate, Part, UsageMetadata, GroundingMetadata, UrlContextMetadata, PromptFeedback, SafetyRating, FinishReason). Body layout (key order, index, responseId, modelVersion, promptTokensDetails, groundingMetadata contents) follows the recorded outputs in the official google-gemini/cookbook (quickstarts/rest/Search_Grounding, Batch_mode, Audio_REST); the stream framing, mid-stream error chunk and continuation protocol follow the official googleapis/go-genai SDK (api_client.go scan / iterateResponseStream, continuation.go). Model behaviour comes from search excerpts of the ai.google.dev pages named per model below; read them directly before trusting a detail they alone support. Ids, signatures, continuation tokens, token counts and text are invented. SSE bodies are data-only (alt=sse) with CRLF line endings; go-genai's splitter accepts CRLF and LF, so a recording will settle which the API sends. Replace each case with a recorded capture (source: recorded) when the live recorder runs. Model: Gemini 3.8 Flash, the thinking model (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.8, docs/generate-content/thinking, docs/generate-content/thought-signatures, docs/gemini-3). Thinking levels low / medium (default) / high, no minimal; it thinks on every request, so thoughtsTokenCount is always present, and thought summary parts (thought: true) appear only with includeThoughts, which the gateway sets when reasoning_effort is passed. Signatures ride on the first functionCall part (parallel calls after it have none) and on the last part of a non-function-call answer; when streaming, on an empty text part in the final chunk. No long decode: that is Gemini 4 Argon only (docs/generate-content/long-decode). Also covers google_search grounding (groundingMetadata laid out as in the cookbook's recorded Search_Grounding output) and url_context (urlContextMetadata, toolUsePromptTokenCount; docs/url-context) and code_execution (executableCode / codeExecutionResult parts between text parts; docs/code-execution and the cookbook's Code_Execution notebook). Error, native and non-chat cases (added 2026-10-28): error_* and stream_error_* follow Google's error model (google.rpc.Status in its HTTP JSON mapping, googleapis google/rpc/code.proto, error_details.proto, google/api/error_reason.proto), the 429 body is a real one captured in google-gemini/gemini-cli's tests; each case.json names its sources and whether a real request can induce it. genai_* and stream_genai_* drive the native google-genai passthrough (GenerateContent / StreamGenerateContent, GenAICountTokens) and pin what the server bills from the relayed body; list_models pins that ListModels never calls GET /v1beta/models.
